title: [cloud#3814·C1a] cloud-connection: binding credential readable by every replica when multi-replica is declared
body:
epic:#3814#1 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BrVu5TqwtmuhsjdEvM
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-dispatched task (child of objectstack-ai/cloud#3814). Maintainer, (2026-11-08, 14:16 UTC): 「现在派三张」 (card 0 + F1 + C1a; C1a splits by repo).

Parent: objectstack-ai/cloud#3814 (EE L2 multi-replica HA, ruled A). Sibling: the cloud half (entitlement cache in `security-enterprise`).

## Problem (read in code)
`packages/cloud-connection/src/connection-credential-store.ts:51-60`: the control-plane binding credential (`oscc_…`) lives in `<cwd>/.objectstack/cloud-connection.json`. The online licence refresh takes its bearer only from that ledger, with no env fallback. Under round-robin the binding ceremony runs on one replica; every other replica never holds the credential, so its online check reports no control plane or lives on grace.

## Do
1. When multi-replica is declared with the Redis cluster driver, store and read the binding credential through a shared store every replica sees (database row or cluster KV; pick one and justify it in the PR). A binding written on any replica is readable by all; unbinding clears it for all.
2. Single node keeps writing and reading the file exactly as today (rule R3).
3. Secrets: the credential must stay encrypted at rest with the platform crypto provider if it moves to the database; never log it.
4. Tests: two-process test (bind on one, read on the other); single-node file path regression test.

## Rules that bind every #3814 child (verbatim rulings on the parent)
R1 peer round-robin. R2 Redis required for multi-replica only. R3 「同意：每张卡都只在"声明多副本并接上 Redis 驱动"时才生效」.

## Done when
PR merged; single-node behaviour byte-identical; with multi-replica declared, every replica resolves the same binding.

## Reader
Dispatched by the cloud#3814 PM thread to one card thread; reviewed and landed by that thread. The cloud half consumes it after a pin bump.

Dedup: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue cloud-connection.json` → 2 hits, both closed and unrelated (#29920, #8357).
